description: Known-ODE rollout prediction on Flyvis-217, trained and evaluated across three model noise sigma levels (0, 0.05, 0.5), compared to noise-free simulation. Experiment 15, arm kode, dataset flyvis_noise_free_blank50_cv00, model flyvis_known_ode, 15 of 15 runs landed. Settings: embedding dim 0, model noise sigma 0.0, 1 epoch, batch 4, data augmentation loop 35, one-step training, MLP precision fp32, W_L1 1e-05. Top row shows rollout traces for 12 cell types over 1,000 frames at 20 ms steps; bottom row shows rollout voltage versus ground-truth voltage as log-density images pooled over 7,207 frames, with Pearson r computed per-neuron and Fisher-z pooled.
facts:
CAPTION: Known-ODE rollout prediction. Known-ODE models (the published checkpoints, fold cv00, re-analysed with the current analysis code, experiment 15) evaluated on central 217-column Flyvis data under three model noise regimes (σ = 0, σ = 0.05, σ = 0.5), tested on held-out stimuli, and compared against the noise-free Flyvis simulation of the same stimuli. Top row (a, b, c): Known-ODE rollout traces for 12 representative cell types over a 20 s window (1,000 frames at ∆t = 20 ms). Green: noise-free ground-truth voltage; black: Known-ODE rollout prediction; red: the visual input of the photoreceptor row. Bottom row (d, e, f): rollout voltage against noise-free ground-truth voltage, pooled over all (neuron, frame) pairs of the 7,207-frame rollout as a log-density image. Pearson r: per-neuron, Fisher-z pooled, on the full rollout.
FACTS:
- experiment: 15: Known ODE re-analysed on degraded Flyvis-217 data
- arm: kode
- runs: 15 of 15 landed
- cells: condition: flyvis_noise_free, flyvis_noise_005, flyvis_noise_05
- dataset: flyvis_noise_free_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_known_ode
- embedding dim: 0
- model noise sigma: 0.0
- epochs: 1
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 35
- training: one-step
- MLP precision: fp32
- regularisers: W_L1 1e-05
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
